title: RetentionStartEvent
description: PACK-09, ADR-039. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.RetentionStartEvent). An explicit, recorded retention-start fact. Retention never starts implicitly: until one of these exists for a record, disposal eligibility fails closed with RETENTION_START_UNDETERMINED (PACK-09 required invariant 15). recorded_at is never before occurred_at. No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
